original_test_intent: Read SMBIOS Type 46 String Property structures and compare each required property with the platform specification.

original_procedure_criteria.criteria: Values match an unspecified platform SPEC.

historical_reviews.v3: RECLASSIFIED to FULLY AUTOMATABLE for Actual collection; missing SPEC affects readiness and formal comparison, not automation capability.

v3_1_conclusion.manual_test_activity: None for read-only collection; engineer supplies the reference and formal verdict.

master_vs_project_parameters.master_default: Collect complete SMBIOS Type 46 data and compare with SPEC.
master_vs_project_parameters.project_inputs: Platform/BIOS identity, SPEC revision and expected handles/associations/property values.
master_vs_project_parameters.coverage_difference: Actual collection is complete without SPEC; comparison coverage remains pending.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a dmidecode release that supports SMBIOS Type 46 and capture unfiltered output plus tool/SMBIOS versions.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Confirm dmidecode support against the installed release.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Official dmidecode documentation/source and DMTF SMBIOS specification for the applicable version.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: No functional replacement; adds version and association-aware parsing.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: All Type 46 records and parent-handle associations remain required.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Tool/SMBIOS versions and platform SPEC for comparison.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Old tools may not decode Type 46; absence cannot be inferred from an unsupported decoder.

missing_inputs: Platform SPEC revision and expected Type 46 matrix
safety_boundaries: Do not filter records or alter firmware
Do not convert Actual into Expected
expected_evidence: Platform/BIOS identity and reference diff when provided
no_automatic_retry: No retry is needed for a valid collection; collection failure remains visible.
engineer_owned_verdict: Firmware engineer decides whether the captured values match SPEC.
review_improvement: KEEP: V3.1 confirms that missing Expected does not block safe automated Actual capture and does not let the agent declare PASS.
